title: Outcame of Cases With Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome Attending Assiut University Child Hospital
brief_summary: Diarrhea-associated hemolytic uremic syndrome (D+HUS) is defined as a prodrome of enteritis followed by thrombocytopenia (\< 150,000/mm3), microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, and signs of variable degrees of renal damage (increase in serum Cr, proteinuria, and/or hematuria) . Our aim is to detect the most reliable early predictors of poor prognosis to identify children at major risk of bad outcome who could eventually benefit from early specific treatments.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all patients less than 18 years diagnosed with Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome
study_population: Patients attending Assiut University Child hospital
